orderGuard.title: Complete the previous step first
orderGuard.description: The selected step is not available until the previous steps are finished.

language.title: Language
language.description: Select the language to use during initial setup.

siteCode.title: Site Code
siteCode.description: Enter a site code registered with the control system or select the default site.
siteCode.intro: Enter a site code or select the default site.
siteCode.label: Site Code
siteCode.validation: Enter an 8-character site code using uppercase letters or numbers.

location.title: Operating Location
location.description: Select the building, floor, and area retrieved from the site code.
location.intro: Select where the robot will operate.
location.defaultSiteHint: The default site can continue without selecting a building or floor.
location.siteCodeHint: Apply a Site Code from the Site Code menu first.

robotInfo.title: Robot Info
robotInfo.description: Set the robot name to register with the control system.
robotInfo.intro: Enter the robot information to register.
robotInfo.name: Robot Name

network.title: Network Setup
network.description: Select the Wi‑Fi network for the robot and switch from the setup AP to the regular network.

gate.title: Network connection is required before sign-in
gate.description: Sign-in talks to an external server, so the robot must be connected to an external Wi‑Fi network first. After connecting, if you are browsing over the robot AP (ROBOT_SETUP), join the same Wi‑Fi network and reopen the WIFI address shown in 'Access addresses' above.
gate.skip: Skip network setup and sign in

network.scanFailed: Could not load the Wi‑Fi list.
network.scanError: An error occurred while requesting a Wi‑Fi scan. {{message}}

access.title: Connection Addresses
access.hint: The Wi‑Fi address may change depending on DHCP. The currently detected address is shown.

summary.apHint: Connected to a temporary network for initial setup.
summary.wifiHint: The robot is connected to a regular Wi‑Fi network.

scan.title: Nearby Wi‑Fi Networks
scan.emptyAp: Live scanning may be limited in AP mode. Enter an SSID manually or temporarily stop the AP and scan again.
scan.emptyWifi: No results were found in regular Wi‑Fi mode. Scan again or enter an SSID manually.
scan.offlineMessage: The AP will be paused and Wi‑Fi rescanned. If ROBOT_SETUP disconnects, reconnect after about 15 seconds and check the list.

connect.title: Connect to Selected Network
connect.descriptionOpen: Connect to {{ssid}}. This is an open network, so no password is required.
connect.descriptionSecure: Connect to {{ssid}}. Enter the password, then start the connection.
connect.requestingWait: Requesting Wi‑Fi connection to "{{ssid}}". Please wait.
connect.requestSent: Wi‑Fi connection requested for "{{ssid}}". Checking connection status.
connect.verifying: Wi‑Fi connection requested for "{{ssid}}". Checking status. ({{attempt}}/{{total}})
connect.confirmedHint: Wi‑Fi connection to "{{ssid}}" confirmed. Check the connected indicator in the list.
connect.pending: The request completed, but the connection to "{{ssid}}" has not been confirmed yet. Scan again and check the connected indicator.
connect.pendingPassword: The request completed, but the connection to "{{ssid}}" has not been confirmed yet. Check the password or scan again.
connect.error: An error occurred while requesting Wi‑Fi connection. {{message}}
connect.switchStart: Starting Wi‑Fi connection. ROBOT_SETUP may disconnect shortly. Use one of the wired/AP/Wi‑Fi addresses below to reconnect.
connect.switchStarted: Wi‑Fi network switching started. ROBOT_SETUP will disconnect shortly. Use one of the wired/AP/Wi‑Fi addresses below to reconnect.
connect.switchInterrupted: The request connection may have dropped while the robot is switching Wi‑Fi. Use one of the wired/AP/Wi‑Fi addresses below to reconnect.

disconnect.confirm: Disconnect the current Wi‑Fi? If you are connected through it, the connection may drop and the robot may switch to the ROBOT_SETUP AP.
disconnect.requestedHint: Wi‑Fi disconnect requested. The current connection may drop and switch to the ROBOT_SETUP AP shortly.
disconnect.reconnectHint: Wi‑Fi disconnect requested. Use the wired/AP connection addresses to reconnect.
disconnect.interrupted: The connection may have dropped while requesting disconnect. Use the wired/AP addresses to reconnect.

mode.title: Wi‑Fi Connection Mode
mode.description: Switching to concurrent mode keeps the ROBOT_SETUP AP on even while connected to external Wi‑Fi. Single mode is enough for most cases.
mode.concurrentButton: Use external Wi‑Fi + ROBOT_SETUP AP together
mode.confirmConcurrent: Switch to using external Wi‑Fi and the ROBOT_SETUP AP at the same time. The AP may restart briefly. Continue?
mode.confirmSingle: Switch to single mode. If already connected to external Wi‑Fi, that connection is kept; otherwise it returns to the ROBOT_SETUP AP. Continue?
mode.changed: {{label}} switch request completed. If the AP restarted, reconnect after 10–20 seconds.

manual.title: Manual Network Entry
manual.description: If the scan list is empty or the SSID is hidden, enter the network name manually.
manual.passwordPlaceholder: Leave blank for an open network

status.title: Wi‑Fi Connection Status
status.locked: Input/selection locked · automatic rescan after completion

network.note: With a single Wi‑Fi interface, it is normal for the connection to drop when switching from the AP to regular Wi‑Fi.

installMode.title: Installation mode
installMode.description: Choose whether this robot is installed with the control server or on its own.
installMode.managedHint: Installs over site Wi-Fi with the control server: site code, operating location, robot registration, and map download/upload.
installMode.standaloneHint: For sites without external network. Finishes the installation on this robot only — no login, site code, robot registration, or map download/upload.
installMode.confirmBody: Stand Alone mode hides the control-server screens (site code, operating location, robot registration, download, upload).
installMode.confirmHint: Switching to managed mode later requires a separate migration once the network is available.

localPlace.title: Installation place
localPlace.description: Name the building, floor, and area the maps are saved under.
localPlace.intro: Rename them to match the site and add the floors and areas you need.
localPlace.hint: One map is saved per area. For multiple floors, add the floors and areas first.

finish.title: Finish installation
finish.description: Commits the saved maps and POIs to this robot.
finish.intro: Pick the map the robot will use, then finish the installation.
finish.noMap: No saved map yet. Run the map scan first.
finish.activeHint: The selected map becomes the one the robot uses; the others are kept as archives.

migration.title: Migrate to managed
migration.description: Connect the maps built in Stand Alone mode to the control server’s buildings, floors, and areas.
migration.startIntro: This robot was installed in Stand Alone mode.
migration.steps: Order: (1) start migration → (2) Wi-Fi and login → (3) fetch places with the site code → (4) connect maps → (5) clean up local places → (6) upload
migration.startHint: Starting the migration reopens the managed screens (site code, operating location, robot registration, download, upload). Saved maps and POIs are kept.
migration.needSiteHint: Connect Wi-Fi, sign in, then enter the site code to fetch the buildings, floors, and areas. Come back here to connect the maps.
migration.mapHint: Pick a building, floor, and area for each map. Connecting also rebuilds the map name from that place and marks POIs that the control server does not have yet for upload.
migration.finishIntro: Every map is connected to a control-server place.
migration.finishHint: Clean up the Stand Alone local place, then upload the maps and POIs from the upload screen.
migration.finishFailed: Failed to clean up local place: {{message}}
